title: 第24章 老鬼登门
novel_title: 苟道剑尊：从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
镇北祠堂周围便是仙人坊市，占地亩许。

    几十个低阶散修在此摆摊，售卖劣质灵药和残破法器。

    陈凡的铁匠摊搭在坊市偏僻角落，仅有一张木桌、一尊铁炉和几柄锻铁锤。

    此时他坐在马扎上，右手握着短刀，用砺石缓慢打磨。

    临近正午，散修渐散，摊前略显冷清。

    忽地，一阵拖沓的脚步声从青石路上传来。

    陈凡没有抬头，神识习惯性地扫过周身数十丈。

    看清来人瞬间，他右手微紧，随即便恢复正常节奏。

    来人是一名佝偻老者，身穿泥点斑驳的旧灰袍，身形极瘦，面容枯槁。

    他一头花白头发乱糟糟地披散着，双眼一大一小，小的清明，大的浑浊死寂。

    身上散发着淡淡的腐朽药草味，还夹杂着一丝阴冷法力波动。

    筑基后期！

    陈凡心中暗中警惕，口中用沙哑声线开口：“道友是修补法器？小本生意，概不赊账。”

    老者走到摊前，用独眼打量陈凡片刻，筑基后期威势散开，随即发出一声沙哑笑声。

    “嘿嘿，老夫这件法器，怕是把你这摊子卖了也赔不起。”

    话音落下，老者将手中一根黑色手杖重重放在木桌上。

    砰的一声，木桌剧烈摇晃。

    那是一根阴灵木打造的手杖，顶端雕刻着恶鬼头颅。

    鬼头脑门处裂开一道细密缝隙，里面隐隐有一股纯正的至阳雷霆法力，正消磨着内里的阵法。

    一阶极品法器，鬼头杖。

    “老……老前辈，您这法器等阶太高，小人这点微末道行，怕是碰都碰不得。”

    陈凡脸色发白，急忙站起身，连连摆手后退三步，眼中全是练气修士面对筑基修士应有的惊恐。

    “少废话。”

    老者坐在旁边的空马扎上，死死盯着陈凡，“老夫路过这里，找人打听过，说你控火手艺在边界一带最稳。老夫等不及郡城百宝阁排队。上面的辟邪雷法极为难缠，你若能补好，少不了你的灵石。若废了，老夫就把你这摊子砸了，顺便收了你的生魂。”

    说完，老者屈指一弹，一块中品灵石排在木桌上。
content_en:
Surrounding the Zhenbei ancestral hall is Xianrenfang City, which covers an area of ​​​​mu.

    Dozens of low-level casual cultivators set up stalls here, selling low-quality elixirs and broken magic weapons.

    Chen Fan's blacksmith stall was set up in a remote corner of Fang City. It only had a wooden table, an iron furnace and a few forging hammers.

    At this time, he was sitting on the horse, holding a short knife in his right hand, slowly polishing it with a sharpening stone.

    As noon approached, the casual practitioners gradually dispersed, and the stall became slightly deserted.

    Suddenly, the sound of shuffling footsteps came from the bluestone road.

    Chen Fan didn't raise his head, and his consciousness swept dozens of feet around him habitually.

    The moment he saw the person clearly, he tightened his right hand slightly, and then returned to his normal rhythm.

    The person who came was a rickety old man, wearing an old gray robe with mottled mud spots. He was extremely thin and had a withered face.

    His gray hair was disheveled, and his eyes were one large and one small, the small one was clear and the big one was muddy and lifeless.

    The body exudes a faint smell of decaying herbs, mixed with a hint of cold mana fluctuations.

    Late stage of foundation building!

    Chen Fan was secretly vigilant and spoke in a hoarse voice: "Fellow Taoist, are you repairing magic weapons? It's a small business and we don't accept credit."

    The old man walked to the stall and looked at Chen Fan with his one eye for a moment. His power in the late stage of foundation building was gone, and then he let out a hoarse laugh.

    "Hey, I'm afraid I won't be able to pay for this magic weapon even if I sell your stall."

    After finishing his words, the old man placed a black cane heavily on the wooden table.

    With a bang, the wooden table shook violently.

    It was a cane made of Yin spirit wood, with an evil ghost's head carved on the top.

    A thin gap opened at the door of Guitou's head, and there was a faint stream of pure Zhiyang Thunder magic power inside, which was consuming the formation inside.

    The first-class magic weapon, the ghost-headed staff.

    "Old... senior, the level of your magic weapon is too high. I'm afraid I can't even touch it with my humble skills."

    Chen Fan turned pale and hurriedly stood up, waving his hands and taking three steps back. His eyes were filled with the fear that a Qi Practicing monk should have when facing a Foundation Establishment monk.

    "Cut the nonsense."

    The old man sat on the empty horse next to him and stared at Chen Fan. "I passed by here and asked someone to inquire. They said that your fire control skills are the most stable in the border area. I can't wait to queue up at the Baibao Pavilion in the county. The evil-proof thunder method above is extremely difficult to deal with. If you can fix it, your spirit stone will be indispensable. If it fails, I will smash your stall and collect your soul."

    After speaking, the old man flicked his finger, and a medium-grade spiritual stone was placed on the wooden table.
title_en: Chapter 24 The old ghost comes to visit
